composition: Compose cleared RGB and transformed hard-alpha feature in an opaque patch-sized intermediate, then restore original source alpha from coverage. This recovers original RGBA byte-exactly at rest. A CanvasItem shader may do this directly using texture samples, without a SubViewport. Ordinary alpha-over on the feathered cleared patch is not sufficient.
review_scope: Approved EXP-005 performance only. Static artwork remains unchanged.

EXP-005.feature_method: original RGB with hard binary alpha and nearest oral RGB filter bleed
EXP-005.underpaint_method: discrete harmonic neighboring-skin extension; estimated pixels are explicitly masked
EXP-005.clearing_method: Only RGB inside mask is estimated; original patch alpha unchanged. Final combined patch MUST reuse original alpha coverage.
